help: Change what you need below, then press Commit changes.
The plan applies to the day you commit it. The station reads it at 09:50 Pacific and does not look again that day.
An untouched plan expires on its own, and the station acquires two bursts at 10:00 and 17:00.
Anything missing or out of range falls back to that same standard schedule, with the reason shown on the status page.
_exposure_us: 100 to 20000, or null to keep the station's own value. The morning image on the status page shows what the scene called for.
_note: Free text. It is copied into the archive next to the frames.
_date: Leave null for today. Set a future date, YYYY-MM-DD Pacific, only to prepare a plan a day or more ahead.
